rules.title: Non-waiver of security deposit and last month's rent protections
rules.requirement: Any lease provision that conflicts with Section 15B, and any waiver by a tenant or prospective tenant of its provisions, is void and unenforceable as against public policy.
rules.coverage_text: All leases, rentals, occupancies and tenancies subject to Section 15B, except vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less that are for a vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.exemptions_text: Section does not apply to any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which is for a vacation or recreational purpose.
rules.quoted_span: Any provision of a lease which conflicts with any provision of this section and any waiver by a tenant or prospective tenant of any provision of this section shall be deemed to be against public policy and therefore void and unenforceable.
